title: One-click deploy pipeline
subtitle: How product teams ship to production on their own, safely.

faqs.q: What is the one-click deploy pipeline?
faqs.a: A button in your repository that tests, approves and ships your change to production, with automatic rollback if something fails.

faqs.q: Why are we changing how we deploy?
faqs.a: Today a release takes 2 days and needs the Platform team. With the pipeline, teams ship in under 30 minutes, on their own.
Any engineer in a product team. Production deploys need one approval from someone else on your team.
From November 10 for web services. Mobile apps join on ENTER_DATE.
In the Actions tab of your repository, and the deploy history at deploy.company.internal.

faqs.q: How do I deploy for the first time?
faqs.a: Merge to main, open Actions and press Deploy. The first time, follow the 10-minute guide linked in the repo.

faqs.q: Are there times I can't deploy?
faqs.a: Yes: no deploys on Fridays after 3 pm or during announced freeze periods, like Black Friday week.
It rolls back on its own. If it doesn't, post in #platform-help with the link to the failed run.
